title: Maguindanao massacre kin still await justice 17 years later

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — When media worker Mark Gilbert Ariola was killed in the Maguindanao massacre on Nov. 23, 2009, his wife, Erlyn Umpad, had given birth to their child just 13 days earlier. Seventeen years later, Umpad said their family continues to wait for the justice they have long sought. She shared her experience during a media briefing organized by the National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) on Monday, marking the 17th anniversary of the massacre that left 58 people dead, including 32 journalists and media workers.
